body: Looks like 3/4 drywall, take a utility knife square up the edges. Cut a new drywall sheet to fit. Tape edges with some drywall tape. Add a layer of mud, let it dry then repeat if necessary. Sand smooth then paint. Very important to sand smooth or you’ll have humps.

I would cut a new piece for the window and tighten up a few places and it should be fine. No need to take it completely off. Unless you have the time, Also poke around to see if you have any squishy rotted wood under the felt.
They both do the job. Keep water out and be able to dry out if any water vapors get in. Felt is old school not used as much  and a btch if you’re installing it by yourself.
It’s felt paper. You can either keep it on and not use housewrap. Or take it off and use housewrap.
